user.title: Navaja Chilena
user.description: Choose which Chilean data to add to Home Assistant.

data.stops: Bus stops (comma-separated codes, e.g. PC615, PA433)
data.train_trips: Limache–Puerto train trips (EFE), comma-separated, e.g. Villa Alemana > Puerto, Viña del Mar > Limache
data.train_return: Also add the return direction of each train trip
data.air: Air quality and UV (based on Home Assistant location)
data.pharmacy_comuna: Commune for pharmacies on duty (optional, e.g. Providencia)
data.crypto: Cryptocurrencies in CLP (Bitcoin and Ethereum, Buda.com)
data.bolsa: Santiago Stock Exchange: IPSA and daily change
data.vehicle_digit: Last digit of your license plate (traffic restriction and vehicle inspection)
data.fuel_types: Cheapest fuel near your home (choose the ones you use)
data.regional_zone: Red Regional city (bus stops outside Santiago)
data.regional_stops: Red Regional stop codes (comma separated, e.g. 1253, P60094)
data.benefit_cards: Your credit/debit cards (to see their discounts)
data.benefit_categories: Discount categories you care about (for your cards)
data.football_team: Your Chilean Primera División team (matches, results and position)
data.football_national: La Roja: national team (matches and results)

error.invalid_stop: Invalid bus stop code. Use a format like PC615.
error.nothing_selected: Select at least one indicator, the Metro or a bus stop.
error.stop_not_found: That bus stop does not exist in Red Movilidad. Check the code (e.g. PC615).
error.invalid_regional_stop: Invalid stop code. Use letters, numbers and hyphens (e.g. P60094).
error.regional_needs_stops: Enter at least one Red Regional stop.
error.regional_needs_zone: Choose the city of those stops.
error.regional_stop_not_found: That stop does not exist in the chosen city. Check the code on the sign or in the Red Regional app.
error.invalid_trip: Invalid train trip. Use «Origin > Destination» with stations of the Limache–Puerto line, e.g. Villa Alemana > Puerto.
